PersonalLives Lost
Cardiovascular disease
Know your numbers: blood pressure, cholesterol, blood sugar
Get a baseline check at any pharmacy or clinic. No insurance needed for a basic blood pressure check. These three metrics predict 80% of cardiovascular risk — all modifiable.
⏱ 30 minEasy to start
Why it works: Patients who know their blood pressure are 3x more likely to take corrective action. Source: American Heart Association.
Estimated impact

If all high-risk adults got annual screenings, ~20,000 cardiovascular deaths could be prevented annually.

PersonalLives Lost
Cardiovascular disease
Shift toward a whole-food, plant-forward diet
Replacing ultra-processed food with whole foods even partially has measurable cardiovascular benefit within weeks. You do not need to be perfect — consistent improvement matters more.
⏱ OngoingSome effort
Why it works: PREDIMED trial found Mediterranean diet reduced cardiovascular events by 30%. Source: NEJM 2013.
Estimated impact

Widespread adoption could prevent ~48,000 cardiovascular deaths annually. Source: JAMA Internal Medicine.

PersonalLives Lost
Cardiovascular disease
Get 150 minutes of moderate aerobic exercise per week
30 minutes five days a week — or 22 minutes daily. Brisk walking counts. Meeting exercise guidelines reduces cardiovascular mortality risk by 35%.
⏱ 30 min/daySome effort
Why it works: Meeting physical activity guidelines reduces cardiovascular mortality risk by 35%. Source: Lancet.
Estimated impact

If physical inactivity rates matched peer nations, ~25,000 cardiovascular deaths could be prevented annually.

Cardiovascular disease
Advocate for healthy food access in your zip code
Attend local planning meetings. Support community gardens, farmers markets, and zoning for grocery stores in food deserts.
⏱ 2 hrs/monthSome effort
Why it works: Communities with farmers markets show measurably higher fruit and vegetable consumption. Source: USDA.
LocalLives Lost🔒 Community tier
Cardiovascular disease
Support community health worker programs in your area
Community health workers are among the most cost-effective cardiovascular disease prevention interventions that exist.
⏱ Donate or volunteerEasy to start
Why it works: CHW programs reduce cardiovascular hospitalizations by 20-30%. Source: American Journal of Public Health.

NationalLives Lost
Cardiovascular disease
Push to redirect agricultural subsidies toward fruits and vegetables
The Farm Bill is renegotiated every 5 years — the single highest-leverage food policy change available. Next cycle: 2028.
⏱ 10 minEasy to start
Why it works: Redirecting 10% of commodity subsidies to produce would increase fruit/vegetable consumption by 6.9% nationally. Source: PLOS Medicine.
Estimated impact

Could prevent ~30,000 cardiovascular deaths annually through improved diet quality.
